frontmatter.name: openspec-apply-change
frontmatter.description: Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change. Use when the user wants to start implementing, continue implementation, or work through tasks.

frontmatter.name: openspec-archive-change
frontmatter.description: Archive a completed change in the experimental workflow. Use when the user wants to finalize and archive a change after implementation is complete.

frontmatter.name: openspec-propose
frontmatter.description: Propose a new change with all artifacts generated in one step. Use when the user wants to quickly describe what they want to build and get a complete proposal with design, specs, and tasks ready for implementation.

frontmatter.name: openspec-sync-specs
frontmatter.description: Sync delta specs from a change to main specs. Use when the user wants to update main specs with changes from a delta spec, without archiving the change.

frontmatter.name: openspec-update-change
frontmatter.description: Update an OpenSpec change by revising its existing planning artifacts and keeping them coherent with one another. Use when the user wants to revise a change's plan, fold new decisions into it, or reconcile its artifacts after an edit. Never edits code.
